about.pull_quote: If I do something, I do it right.
about.bio_p1: Backend engineer. I've worked on systems that move billions of dollars and I'm also building a dog walking app. The scale is different, the care isn't.
about.bio_p2: I lean toward the problems that have real stakes. Distributed systems, data migrations, architectures that need to hold up when things get serious. Fullstack when needed, backend by choice.
about.bio_p3: Currently at Capital One in Mexico City. Previously at Trimble. Always shipping something on the side.

experience.capitalone_desc: At Capital One Mexico City, I started on Financial Spreading, heavily involved in a full Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration across 10 microservices, refactoring legacy dependencies and migrating 100K+ customer records, saving $27K a year and improving performance across C# services on AWS supporting an $80B+ commercial banking portfolio. I then moved to the Pricing Model, maintaining a Dynamic Pricing Engine in Python that supports $50B+ in commercial deals. High stakes, real scale.
experience.trimble_desc: Worked on SketchUp's Extension Warehouse, a SPA where I shipped bug fixes, new features, and SEO improvements that reached real users at scale. Built an AI-powered chatbot using a RAG architecture inside a serverless setup. Automated developer workflows with Python and contributed to automated testing across teams.

projects.huellitas_tagline: The platform connecting pet owners with trusted walkers.
projects.huellitas_desc: Production-ready mobile platform with scheduled bookings, real-time GPS tracking, and secure in-app payments. Built to scale from day one.

contact.cta_sub: If you're working on something ambitious and need someone who genuinely cares about what they build, I want to hear about it.
